data.gender_notes: Jagpati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jagpati is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Goddess of the Earth'. In Hindu mythology, Jagpati is believed to be the divine mother who nurtures and protects the earth. She is also known as Bhagavati, the goddess of wealth, fertility, and prosperity. This name signifies strength, stability, and the power of creation.
data.spiritual_meaning: The embodiment of the earth and nurturing mother

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagpati total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name is often associated with prosperity, good fortune, and the abundance of nature.

Jagpati is believed to be the caretaker of the universe, and her name imparts a sense of gratitude and reverence for the natural world.

historical_references.reference: Jagpati was an incarnation of God Vishnu and is considered the founder of the Jagannatha Temple at Puri, Odisha, India. He appeared around 1100 AD during the Eastern Ganga Dynasty.
